title: Stockline cuts its price for a few days
unseen: Every price notice so far raised a price; none lowered it, and none was limited in time.
expected: Nothing bought over the cap; the shop keeps serving customers; no rebalance asked for (nothing is blocked).

words.summary: Kept the buy policy on Stockline with no cache. Its temporary price drop to 0.01 (reverting to 0.03 after three days) still gives a 0.04 margin per query against the 0.05 sell price, and stays within the 0.03 cap. No purchases or software changes needed. I'll revisit when the price reverts to 0.03, which still leaves a 0.02 margin.
